changelog:
  1.2.1   2026-09-22  patch        State=open, Size=lg, Style=control now ships a TextCard — v2 (headline hidden, body + CTA link) as default .content, the shape the Split Aside rows use. .content on this variant is still a plain frame (needs manual Add Slot).
  1.2.0   2026-09-22  minor        Added Style variant (default/control). control = ControlButton — v2 (media, md) as .icon-start instead of the trailing chevron, .label on heading-5; for accordion rows that drive media (Split Aside). Existing variants renamed with Style=default (no visual change).
  1.1.0   2026-09-03  minor        Added Size variant (default/lg). lg matches the FAQ "Large / Accordion" use case: .label upgraded to heading-6 (was s2a/typography/label, 14px) to match real question-text scale (previously a stray non-canonical "Title 5" style, not part of the s2a/typography scale). Bound previously-unbound .trigger gap to spacing/xs on both existing Size=default variants. KNOWN ISSUE: State=open, Size=lg's .content lost its native Slot during cloning (degraded to a plain frame) — needs manual "Add Slot" in Figma UI to restore parity with State=open, Size=default.
  1.0.0   2026-08-04  init         Initial release
